verdict.rationale: Supabase Database Webhooks let users define triggers on INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE table events that automatically fire HTTP calls (e.g., to Edge Functions or external systems), and Supabase Cron adds scheduled recurring jobs, while Realtime Postgres Changes and Queues round out event-driven automation — a direct match for 'define rules that trigger actions automatically on events.' missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that webhooks/cron work reliably in production (community evidence is largely about other features), and no probe test of webhook/cron execution.
